List journal entries, newest first. You can filter by project, tags, and an ISO date range (inclusive). The text result is JSON. The `limit` field keeps the result small.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `project` | `string` | no | Only entries of this project. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Only entries that have all of these tags. |
| `from` | `string` | no | Only entries from this ISO timestamp (inclusive). |
| `to` | `string` | no | Only entries up to this ISO timestamp (inclusive). |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Most entries to return, newest first. The maximum is 500. Default: `50`. |

## Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry list](/gournal/docs/reference/mcp/output-shapes/#entry-list).
